releases.name: 30th Celebration: Ditto Premium Collection & Figure Collection (Mew & Mewtwo)
releases.products: Ditto Premium Collection, Figure Collection (Mew & Mewtwo)
releases.note: Delayed from 6 November. Toymate told pre-order customers: "Our supplier has informed us of an unexpected delay with production and the supply of stock to Toymate. As a result, the release date has now been moved to 20-Nov-26." EB Games also lists both products for 20 November 2026. Expect other retailers to follow.

releases.name: Aura Seeker
releases.note: Reported as the next Japanese main set, releasing in Japan on 27 November 2026. Its English-language counterpart is expected to be called Flowing Fists (see below) - no Australian date yet.

releases.name: 30th Celebration: Sylveon ex Tin & Greninja ex Tin
releases.products: Sylveon ex Tin, Greninja ex Tin (4-pack version at some retailers), Mega Forces Tin (listed by EB Games)
releases.note: Some retailers sell the 5-pack version of these tins from 6 November (see Wave 4); this December date is the 4-pack version. EB Games also lists a Mega Forces Tin for 4 December. The Binder Collection was also originally slated for this wave, but Big W shipped it early in Australia alongside the Wave 1 launch on 16 September - it is not part of this December release here.

releases.name: Valentine's Box
releases.products: Valentine's Box, 20 Collect & Share booster packs, To/From label stickers and sticker sheets, Mailbox-style box
releases.note: The first-ever Pokemon TCG Valentine's Day box. It holds 20 Collect & Share booster packs, 2 sheets of To/From label stickers, and a box that turns into a mailbox with 3 sticker sheets to decorate it. The card checklist has not been revealed. US MSRP is $14.99, with a US release of 15 January 2027. Listed on an Australian distributor's schedule for 22 January 2027 (SKU 10-10734-105). Distributor dates can shift, so treat this as the current expected date until retailers confirm it.

releases.name: Pokemon Day 2027 Collection
releases.note: The yearly Pokemon Day (27 February) collection. Contents for the 2027 edition have not been officially detailed yet. The 2026 edition was a low-priced box with one stamped foil Pikachu promo, a Pokemon coin and 3 booster packs, so expect something similar, but that is not confirmed for 2027. Listed on an Australian distributor's schedule for 29 January 2027 (SKU 10-10731-108). Distributor dates can shift, so treat this as the current expected date until retailers confirm it.

releases.name: Flowing Fists
releases.note: The expected English-language counterpart to Japan's Aura Seeker (see above), and the seventh main Mega Evolution series set, following Delta Reign. No official English or Australian release date yet - unofficial coverage points to 5 February 2027, unconfirmed by The Pokemon Company. Leaked preview imagery reportedly features Mega Lucario ex and Sigilyph ex, also unconfirmed. EB Games has typically opened pre-orders for new main sets around three months ahead of release, which would put a Flowing Fists pre-order window around early November 2026 if that pattern holds - worth watching even without a confirmed set date.

releases.name: Mega Rayquaza ex Premium Tournament Collection
releases.products: Mega Rayquaza ex Premium Tournament Collection, 4 foil promos incl. Mega Rayquaza ex, Dragon Shield sleeves (65) and deck box, 8 booster packs
releases.note: A tournament-player box built around the full-art Mega Rayquaza ex promo, the card cut from the international Delta Reign set. It also has three more foil promos (Zinnia's Trust, Adventure Lantern and Mega Rayquaza Cap) and a Legendary Summit Stadium card pair. Accessories are Dragon Shield: 65 themed sleeves and a deck box. Rounding it out are a Pokemon coin, 8 booster packs and a Pokemon TCG Live code. US MSRP is $49.99, and it is sold wherever Pokemon TCG products are sold, not as a Pokemon Center exclusive. Listed on an Australian distributor's schedule for 12 February 2027 (SKU 10-10688-101). Distributor dates can shift, so treat this as the current expected date until retailers confirm it.
